title: Melbourne Synagogue Arson Ruling
body: A Melbourne court ruled the East Melbourne Synagogue arsonist acted out of mental instability, not hatred towards Jews, sparking concern amid a surge in attacks on Jewish institutions.

title: NYC Mayor Supports Shul
body: Outgoing NYC Mayor Eric Adams visited Park East Synagogue in Manhattan, showing support after the shul was targeted by an anti-Israel protest. Protesters had shouted anti-Israel slogans outside the building.
